description: Generated by tools/gauntlets/builds.py; edit the builds there, not here. Synergy builds finished (12 tiles, 4 dice) against Sector 3.

goodstuff.name: Goodstuff (control)
goodstuff.notes: No theme: solid commons and uncommons. The bar every themed build has to clear.

feed_line.name: Feed Line
feed_line.notes: Relays pass each die down a row and pay out at the end. Receiver Dish (8 when fed) gets Booster Stage's +2; Relay Terminal scales with feeds; Crescendo counts every activation.

firestarter.name: Firestarter
firestarter.notes: Napalm Vent in the centre burns the target whenever any of its 8 neighbours fires, and Hex Coil adds 2 damage per status applied. Full adds Value Exchange to turn 1s into 6s for Flashpoint and Status Catalyst.

pinpoint.name: Pinpoint
pinpoint.notes: Stacks Exposed (+stacks on each single-target hit) and cashes it with many small hits: Chain Cannon hits twice, Ratchet and Overclock grow per use. Nudge Down and Bump make 4s.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.notes: Shields persist, so stack them, then turn them into damage: Ballast Tanks feeds a 1 straight down into Discharge Plate (2x shields spent). Full adds Ram Plating (damage = shields, no spend), Fortress Protocol and Shield Siphon.

redline.name: Redline
redline.notes: Fill the drive, then hold it full: Preflight Interlock deals 3x die while fully charged. Toll Relays feed into it and still pass the die once the drive is full. Brownout Plating shields you while it's filling.

capacitor_gun.name: Capacitor Gun
capacitor_gun.notes: The opposite of Redline: bank charge and spend it every turn. Toll -> Afterburner -> Arc Tap in one row; Deadweight Drive pays off the charge you just spent.

phantom_fleet.name: Phantom Fleet
phantom_fleet.notes: More dice: holograms from Pilot Light, Holo-Duplicator, Die Splitter (and Fabricator, Phantom Squadron). Pays off with Swarm Battery, Broadside and Overclock Coil. Pilot Light's 1 feeds Chaff Pod.

snake_eyes.name: Snake Eyes
snake_eyes.notes: Twin-dice payouts. Inverter feeds Lucky Seven (a die and its flip always sum to 7); Pair Lock wants matches, which Bump, Nudge Down and Re-Roll help make. Full sells the Dice Cannon for Welder -> Ablative Charge (welded 6s).

clockwork.name: Clockwork
clockwork.notes: Countdowns, wound by Fuse Cutter (counts every other countdown down by the die). Echo Relay feeds it so it fires twice. Doubler feeds Countdown Cannon.

static_field.name: Static Field
static_field.notes: Control the enemy's dice and intents. Scrambled flips dice they're handed, so Turncoat Cannon (10 vs Scrambled) can hand over 6s; Grounding Rod hands them 1s; Weakened, Jammed, Cryo Lance and Counter-Battery blunt what's left.

boxcars.name: Boxcars
boxcars.notes: High faces and area damage. Bumps and Value Exchange push dice to 5-6 for Sweeping Battery (all enemies) and Grudge Cannon; Flak Cannon in the centre counts its 8 neighbours. Full adds Chaos Explosion.

gun_deck.name: Gun Deck
gun_deck.notes: Two columns of guns around Amplifiers (+2 to the tiles above and below), with Reloader in the middle giving every limited tile around it another use. Full adds War Footing and a Booster Stage feeding the left column.

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.notes: Hurt yourself for power, then pass the bill on. Blowtorch's self-Burn moves to the enemy with Countermeasures, where Heat Sink (and Flashpoint) feed on it; Leeching Shot and Blood Valve trade hull. Cinder Turbine charges off your Burn.
